artifact.name: agent_vega_data_cross_validated_v1
artifact.title: ISGs scored inhibitory by both delivery methods
artifact.description: The 37 genes present in both screens, carrying each screen's normalized infection value and the source row of each input record, so every value here is traceable to a cell of the supplementary workbooks. Every gene in the lentivirus table is also in the overexpression table, which is expected: the lentivirus assay was run on the 65 overexpression hits.
